{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABV_DX7Q", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6Pzg_hd2I", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 31, "title": "Support PMX group morphs targeting vertex and bone morphs, with a private real-model viewer", "body": "## Problem

The current loader supports direct type 1 vertex morphs and direct type 2 bone morph playback, but its PMX type 0 **group morph** logic only pre-bakes direct references to type 1 into a position morph target. Group references to type 2 bone morphs are ignored. A VMD or interactive weight applied to such a group does not perform the intended bone deformation.

This Issue follows the completed direct bone morph [#28](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/28) and SDEF [#26](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/26).

### Real MMD model for optional local inspection

Primary candidate: **DONburi Room / donburiroom "ダンボール箱" ver.1.1a**, from the creator's original distribution/instructions:
https://donburiroom.blog8.fc2.com/blog-entry-153.html

The creator explicitly describes:
- `蓋*開`: lid-opening bone morph
- `底*開`: bottom-opening bone morph
- `たたむ`: box-folding bone morph
- **`たたむ全`: group morph** combining folding and lid/bottom-opening morphs

This is an especially clear real PMX case of **group → bone** with visible 0–1 results. The distribution description is evidence, **not** proof from inspecting PMX bytes. After an authorized local download, verify the PMX has type 0 morph `たたむ全` referencing type 2 morphs, record the observed names/types and inspect the archive README/license. The author permits modifications and use in videos/stills on the page, but **do not assume that this grants rehosting or redistribution**.

Secondary/fallback: identify a different legitimately distributed PMX with confirmed type 0 → type 2 references if this package is unavailable or the real PMX differs from the description. YYB式初音ミク 10th may be explored locally, but its exact group-to-bone links have not been verified.

## Implementation

- Extend PMX type 0 group handling to propagate group morph weights to **direct type 1 vertex** and **direct type 2 bone** targets, with per-element influence ratio (effective contribution = group weight × element ratio), while retaining direct target weights.
- Reuse the existing `MMDBoneMorphController` and `MMDAnimationHelper` pose/animation ordering. Apply group→bone once before IK, grants and physics in both ordinary and `pmxAnimation: true` modes; no accumulated transforms across frames or seeks.
- Preserve public PMX morph names and indices in `morphTargetDictionary` / `morphTargetInfluences`, including for VMD morph-name lookup and direct interactive sliders. Avoid double-applying pre-baked group→vertex contributions when implementing dynamic group evaluation.
- Handle multiple groups affecting one target, direct + group morph weights, shared targets and file-order composition deterministically. Do not silently replace or lose contributions.
- **Nested group semantics:** PMX can encode groups referencing groups, but babylon-mmd explicitly ignores sub-group morphs to better match MMD ([reference implementation](https://github.com/noname0310/babylon-mmd/blob/master/src/Runtime/mmdMorphControllerBase.ts), and its [0.45.0 changelog](https://github.com/noname0310/babylon-mmd/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)). Check/document the MMD-consistent policy and implement/test it; **do not automatically implement arbitrary recursive expansion**. Never infinite-loop on malformed self/cyclic references.
- References to unimplemented UV/additional-UV/material morph targets must remain explicitly unsupported without corrupting geometry, materials, skeletons, or morph indices. Full material/UV morph support is out of scope.
- Keep `mmd-parser ^1.1.4` if its existing group and bone morph data/types suffice; no new parser release should be required for this issue unless a concrete parser defect is demonstrated.

## Local real-model viewer (not a merge gate)

- Safely extend the existing **loopback-only** `npm run dev:sdef` viewer to load a legitimately downloaded PMX/textures from a Git-ignored folder such as `examples/assets/private/group-morph/`; do not replace the existing SDEF or bone-morph views.
- Display parsed **group (type 0) name and referenced morph indices/types/names and ratios**, highlighting type 2 bone morph links; list target bones and show a diagnostic if no group→bone relation is present.
- Provide a group-weight slider (0 → 0.5 → 1 → 0), direct-target control/comparison and reset; the creator's `たたむ全` should visibly fold/open the box when present, without drift. Allow optional private VMD input if available.
- No model, textures, archive, licenses, screenshots, or third-party motion should be automatically downloaded or added to Git, Actions artifacts, npm packages, Pages or public example assets. Review the actual license/README locally.
- Existing public examples (models, motions, screenshots, asset manifest, Pages URLs) stay unchanged. Any potential future public example replacement is a **separate license-reviewed Issue**.

## Fully automated pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Generated PMX fixture using the installed released parser contains distinct type 0 group, type 1 vertex and type 2 bone morphs, with nonzero/asymmetric data, fractional group ratios, and stable original indices/names.
- [ ] Independent CPU reference tests compare direct-only, group-only, combined and multiple group contributions at weights 0, 0.5, 1 and after reset.
- [ ] Group→vertex applies exactly once with morph-before-BDEF/SDEF skinning; group→bone changes actual bones and skinned geometry, not a dummy position morph target.
- [ ] Weight changes from VMD tracks and interactive changes produce consistent effects; paused, stopped, repeated `update(0)`, seek, loop, pose reset, enabling/disabling bone morph, helper reattachment/transfers, and `pmxAnimation: true` do not cause drift/double-application.
- [ ] Defined/tested behavior for nested, invalid, out-of-range and cyclic group references is safe and consistent with the documented MMD compatibility policy; no recursion or crashes.
- [ ] Unsupported group→UV/material links do not silently mutate unrelated state or falsely claim those features are supported.
- [ ] WebGL2 browser rendering asserts resulting deformation against independent reference; native WebGPU is tested where an adapter is available, retaining existing SDEF and outline regression coverage.
- [ ] The viewer accepts a private actual PMX via MMDLoader, lists real group→bone targets, and exposes controls; absent third-party models must never fail CI.
- [ ] Private viewer/assets are excluded from `npm pack`, `npm run build:examples`, public Pages URLs and build manifests; server remains loopback-only with safe path/extension checks.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run test:browser`, `npm run build:examples`, `npm run test:examples` and isolated package consumer regressions all pass before merge.
- [ ] No manual licensed-model acquisition, human visual approval, credentialed download or post-merge deployment verification is required to complete this Issue.

## Required post-merge verification

**None** for implementation Issue/PR completion. Real-model manual inspection may be recorded as an optional follow-up; already-open [#30](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/30) tracks deferred SDEF/direct bone-morph checks and should not be closed or expanded automatically.

## References

- [Author's cardboard-box distribution and morph descriptions](https://donburiroom.blog8.fc2.com/blog-entry-153.html)
- [PMX 2.0/2.1 morph types and group offset layout](https://github.com/dskjal/OpenMMD/blob/main/docs/specification/pmx2.1-specification.md)
- [babylon-mmd group evaluation](https://github.com/noname0310/babylon-mmd/blob/master/src/Runtime/mmdMorphControllerBase.ts)
